mapper.select: /* egovframework.smartcity.mapper.ComplaintMapper.selectComplaintDetail */ SELECT COMPLAINT_ID AS complaintId, TITLE AS title, CATEGORY AS category, CONTENT AS content, PETITIONER_NAME AS petitionerName, PETITIONER_TEL AS petitionerTel, OCCUR_ADDRESS AS occurAddress, DISTRICT AS district, RELATED_FAC_ID AS relatedFacId, TO_CHAR(REG_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS regDate, STATUS AS status, ASSIGNED_DEPT AS assignedDept, HANDLER_NAME AS handlerName, TO_CHAR(RESOLVE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS resolveDate, RESOLVE_COMMENT AS resolveComment, SATISFACTION AS satisfaction FROM TB_CIVIL_COMPLAINT WHERE COMPLAINT_ID = #{complaintId}
mapper.update: /* egovframework.smartcity.mapper.ComplaintMapper.updateComplaintStatus */ UPDATE TB_CIVIL_COMPLAINT SET STATUS = #{status}, HANDLER_NAME = #{handlerName}, RESOLVE_COMMENT = #{resolveComment}, RESOLVE_DATE = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'RESOLVED' THEN SYSDATE ELSE RESOLVE_DATE END WHERE COMPLAINT_ID = #{complaintId}
